title: Fix race condition between create_task, move_task_stage and boardStore causing task card disappearance
commitMessage: fix(tasks): eliminate race conditions between create_task, move_task_stage and boardStore
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer & react-tailwind-artisan)

sensors.frontend_bundle: pass (npm run build, 0 errors, built in 5.16s)

summary: Eliminated task card disappearance race condition when quickly creating and dragging/moving tasks: (1) Early Persistence Invariant: atomically registers tasks into state.tasks and saves to disk immediately before starting slow worktree creation and stage hooks in create_task; (2) In-Memory Fallback Invariant: checks AppState.tasks in internal_move_task_stage if task is not yet on disk; (3) Safe Catch Reversion: replaced blind loadTasks() in boardStore.ts moveTask catch block with localized single-card revert, protecting in-flight optimistic cards from being wiped; (4) Concurrent Stage Preservation: reloads and preserves concurrently modified stage_id, status, and board_id upon worktree completion, explicitly syncing updated_tasks before disk save (cf9485a); (5) In-Flight Move Reconciliation: preserves user's columnId, status, and persona in boardStore.ts addTask reconciliation if user moved the card during background creation; (6) Zero In-Memory Task Loss Invariant: merges in-memory state.tasks with disk tasks in run_agent, preventing stale disk snapshots from wiping memory; (7) Zero Invisible Tasks & Multi-Board Isolation: updated KanbanBoard.tsx to enforce !boardHasCol && activeHasCol, preventing multi-board task leakage while guaranteeing zero invisible tasks (cf9485a).

rootCauses.issue: Slow worktree creation and transition hooks executed before task persistence
rootCauses.explanation: In create_task, the new task was persisted to disk only after git worktree creation and enter hooks completed. Because worktree initialization takes 200ms-1500ms, any rapid user move or autorun dispatched during this window resulted in 'Task not found' errors. Resolved by atomically registering the task into in-memory state.tasks and saving to disk immediately prior to worktree creation.

rootCauses.issue: Blind loadTasks() catch block evicted in-flight optimistic cards
rootCauses.explanation: When moveTask caught a backend error (e.g. temporary rejection), it unconditionally invoked loadTasks(). This replaced Zustand state with the disk snapshot, which did not yet include newly created tasks whose disk write was still pending, causing cards to vanish from the board. Resolved by safely reverting only the affected task's position and preserving optimistic/in-flight cards.

rootCauses.issue: Worktree completion post-update clobbered concurrent stage movements
rootCauses.explanation: When worktree creation finished, create_task unconditionally appended the original new_task (with stage 'backlog') back to disk, reverting any stage changes made by the user while the worktree was being set up. Resolved by reloading tasks from disk/memory and preserving the latest stage_id, status, and board_id.

rootCauses.issue: Stale disk snapshot erased in-memory tasks in run_agent
rootCauses.explanation: run_agent reloaded tasks from disk and assigned *guard = disk_tasks, erasing any tasks registered in state.tasks that had not yet flushed to disk. Resolved by merging in-memory state.tasks with disk tasks before updating the guard.

rootCauses.issue: Optimistic card reconciliation reset user-moved column in addTask
rootCauses.explanation: When create_task completed and returned the confirmed task, addTask reconciliation unconditionally reset columnId to mapped.columnId ('backlog'). If the user had already dragged the card to 'dev', this snapped the card back to 'backlog'. Resolved by checking existing store state and preserving user-selected columnId, status, and persona, syncing to the backend via move_task_stage if necessary.

rootCauses.issue: Incomplete board column matching in KanbanBoard task filter
rootCauses.explanation: KanbanBoard task filtering could drop tasks if boardId drifted or didn't match the active board. Resolved by verifying whether the task's column exists on the active board, guaranteeing visibility.

rootCauses.issue: Disk save in create_task omitted updated_tasks in-memory stage sync
rootCauses.explanation: While new_task was updated with in-memory stage changes, updated_tasks (loaded prior to the mutex lock) was not updated with the new stage/status for new_task.id before save_tasks_to_disk. Remediation in cf9485a explicitly synchronized updated_tasks with new_task.stage_id, status, and board_id before writing to disk.

rootCauses.issue: Naive activeHasCol check leaked tasks across distinct boards
rootCauses.explanation: The initial zero-invisible-tasks filter checked activeHasCol unconditionally, which caused tasks belonging to other boards sharing identical column names (e.g. 'backlog', 'ready') to leak onto the active board. Remediation in cf9485a refined this to !boardHasCol && activeHasCol, ensuring self-healing only applies when the task's declared board does not possess that column.

remediationCommitMessage: fix(board): restore multi-board isolation and sync updated_tasks stage in create_task
